metadata.description: Copilot skills for migrating Exchange Web Services (EWS) applications to Microsoft Graph API

plugins.name: ews-migration
plugins.description: Complete EWS-to-Graph API migration skill set. Guides developers through discovery, documentation, instrumentation, testing, refactoring, and validation of EWS application migrations with human-in-the-loop checkpoints.

plugins.name: ews-app-usage
plugins.description: Guides tenant admins through EWS usage data collection for a single tenant, analysis, and reporting. Orchestrates app registration setup, data collection via Graph API, report generation, and provides quick-launch access to Excel, Power BI, and M365 Admin Center reports.
